name: 2010 Shanghai Jiaozhou Road high-rise fire response zone
source_title: Public records: Shanghai Jiaozhou Road 11.15 major fire
evidence: The Shanghai Jiaozhou Road 11.15 major fire occurred on 2010-11-15 at Jiaozhou Road 728 in Jing'an District, Shanghai. The project uses this historical fire location as the emergency response target.
mapping_note: Road polyline segments intersecting the urban-fire response buffer are marked as fire risk. Real-time AMap traffic status is overlaid by road name and polyline distance to convert congested roads into higher cost.
